name: PostFinance Checkout Payments
description: Hosted PostFinance Checkout transactions, signed webhooks, refunds, cancellation and reconciliation through the official Checkout REST SDK.

applicationUserId.label: Application user ID
applicationUserId.description: PostFinance Checkout API application user ID.

authenticationKey.label: Authentication key
authenticationKey.description: PostFinance Checkout API authentication key for the application user.

spaceId.label: Space ID
spaceId.description: PostFinance Checkout space ID that owns transactions and webhook signing keys.

testMode.label: Use preview environment
testMode.description: Defaults to PREVIEW for sandbox testing. Disable only for the configured LIVE environment.

supportedCurrencies.label: Supported currencies
supportedCurrencies.description: Optional allowlist for currencies enabled in the PostFinance Checkout space; defaults to CHF.
